[Quest 2nd Class] Sebina The Priest

Sebina The Priest

NPC 'Sebina The Priest' is a great priestess of the 'Church of Devias'. She has received intel which suggests that the 'Scroll of the Emperor', an ancient record detailing Muren Reksmilon's battle against Sekneum, has been located amongst Kundun's minions. Anyone which reads the 'Scroll of the Emperor', can obtain knowledge which will increase their abilities. Agree to find the item for 'Sebina The Priest' and she will allow you gain its ability first.

Quest Start Location

Devias, Sebina The Priest Coordinates [183,32]

Quest Conditions

Character level 150 or higher

1 million zen

Quest Reward

+10 stat points

Unlock [Part 2]

Conversation

Have you heard of Muren Reksmilon, who became the first emperor of MU after he defeated Sekneum and unified the continent? There are rumors that the 'Scroll of the Emperor', where this story is recorded, has been found.

The 'Scroll of the Emperor' contains a record of the treasures left by the three heroes of the Divine War, including Muren himself. The God of Light, Rugard, has given you the mission to find the 'Scroll of the Emperor'.

You must offer 1 million Zen to Rugard if you want to receive this mission. Would you like to accept the mission and find the 'Scroll of the Emperor'?

According to the rumors, the 'Scroll of the Emperor' can be found in the Dungeon, Lost Tower or Atlans.

'Scroll of the Emperor' should contain information about the treasures that the three heroes of the Divine War have left behind.

Scroll of the emperor

Story: Scroll of the emperor

'Scroll of the Emperor' contains historical records of the first emperor of the continent, Muren, as well as what happened during the Peace Festival commemorating the victory in the war and the unification of the continent.

Muren Reksmilon unified the three Muren ended the Divine War with Arca's Great Mage Etramu Renos and Noria's Elf Queen Lunedill Diochell, and was revered as a hero.

After the empire was established and peace achieved, everyone in the continent swore their loyalty to the emperor, and they offered treasures as a token.

The 'Broken Sword', the 'Tear of Elf', and the 'Soul Shard of Wizard'. The 'Broken Sword' was offered by the Dark Knights of Lorencia as a symbol of their bravery and loyalty; whising for the empire's prosperity.

The 'Tear of Elf' was offered by the Elf Queen Lunedill Diochell as a token of her vow to strengthened the unity between elves and humans.

The 'Soul Shard of Wizard' was offered by Great Mage Etramu as a symbol of his bow to dedicate his power for the peace and freedom of the empire.

From the records of the Peace Festival held in the 10th year.

Frequent Questions

Where to find the Scroll of the emperor?

Dungeon, Lost Tower and Atlans.

What monsters drops the Scroll of the emperor?

Dungeon: Poison Bull fighter, Dark Knight, Gorgon.

Lost Tower: Shadow, Poison Shadow, Cursed Wizard, Death Cow, Devil.

Atlans: Bahamut, Vepar, Valkyrie.

    Broken Sword

    The 'Broken Sword' is said to have originated from Muren's sword, the 'Apocalypse', which Muren himself broke after he unified the continent, in the hopes that war would never happen again.

    The Dark Knights of Lorencia also broke their swords and offered them to Muren, swearing that they would only use their swords when absolutely needed.

    Muren was greatly pleased and gave them the title of 'Blade Knight'. Since then, Dark Knights seeking to become Blade Knights break their swords to demonstrate their will.

    Tear of Elf

    The 'Tear of Elf' is the crystallized tear of an elf, dropped during the coming of age ceremony. The one offered to Muren was the Tear of Elf Queen, Lunedill Diochell.

    Soul Shard of Wizard

    The 'Soul Shard of Wizard' is a magic stone that symbolizes the strong mind of a Dark Wizard, and it is said that Etramu offered it to Muren as a symbol of his vow.

    Abyssal Eye

    The 'Abyssal Eye' is a material that cannot be found in this world, created from the transformation of materials during dimensional transfer. It contains the memories of the era.

    To those who watch over the dimensions, the 'Abyssal Eye' is an important symbol.

    Frequent Questions

    Where to find the Broken Sword, Tear of Elf, Soul Shard of Wizard or Abyssal Eye?

    Lost Tower, Atlans and Tarkan.

    What monsters drops the Broken Sword, Tear of Elf, Soul Shard of Wizard or Abyssal Eye?

    Lost Tower: Death Knight, Death Gorgon, Balrog.

    Atlans: Great Bahamut, Silver Valkyrie, Lizard King, Hydra.

    Tarkan: Mutant, Bloody Wolf, Iron Wheel.

    Extra Info

    PARTY

    During party hunting, if there is a party member who has been given a quest, the quest item will be dropped from the monster. However, item acquisition is only possible for the character who is performing the quest.

    ITEM

  • If you have a quest item in your inventory, the item will no longer drop when hunting.

  • Dropped quest items disappear after 1 minute.

  • Acquired quest items cannot be stored in the warehouse.

  • Acquired quest items cannot be sold in the shop.

  • Acquired quest items cannot be traded.

  • Secondary quest items can only be acquired for each class.
